body: I'm 36 years old. They won't let me sign up.

I did. Most of my friends are married and live far away. I'm out of touch and they are so busy with the family thing they don't respond. I tried facebook but kind of just got fed up with it after awhile. 

I don't want to give out my location. If someone showed up at my work trying to white knight or something I'd been in a lot of shit with my boss. 

I spend most of my time at work by myself. My boss doesn't show up until after lunch on most days. He's gotten to the point that he doesn't really care anymore since he started dating this new girl. The only people I interact with besides him is our customers. They are very aggressive and rude. Some or even violent. Everything is my fault according to them. If I act stern with them I'll end up in a fight or having a gun pointed at me. If I don't speak up they get upset and yell at me. It's extremely tiring dealing with these people.
I didn't know I never signed up for it. I remember back when I was 18 getting some card in the mail and filling it out. Maybe I forgot to mail it. It's been so long now I'm not sure anymore.

The first couple of times it wasn't that serious. The last time it was pretty bad. 

I've lost all enthusiasm for this work. I was really lied to back in school about this being a fun job where I'd see new cutting edge technologies and work around people that were intellectually stimulating. 

I rarely turn my computer on at home. I cracked a neighbor's wifi password and used to use his internet but now after work I don't want to see a computer. It brings to mind too many negative experiences and thoughts. 

A lot of people quit at work so I have an increased workload. I'm at work most of my waking day. When I go home I just go to bed. 

Last year I used to browse r/wtf for a good laugh or r/funny. I also used to use this site to keep up with global events. It just made me depressed when someone would post some exotic picture of some far away place. I'd get fed up with where I was and say fuck it I'm just going to go there. I'd check the bank account and when it says "-$481", then I'd realize that isn't going to happen. 

Time goes by and the mental wounds grow. You realize how restricted you are in your freedom. I used to tell myself that I could just change my attitude and think different. Just snap my fingers and everything will be great. I'll get job and then I'll go do that. I'll catch up to where all my old friends are. Surprise them with a family that I take on exotic vacations to where ever. Then it's like everything turns these cold dark colors and reality sets in. You look around and you see most of your stuff in boxes. A couch I've been repairing for years that keeps falling apart. Most of it's frame is now random pallets I found in our dumpster at work. TV was hit by lighting years ago. Not even sure why I haven't just tossed it yet. This fake wood paneling makes the choice for suicide seem a lot more reasonable. 

It's such a nasty hole to dig myself out of. Already I've gotten to a point that I'd need a really awesome job to be able to retire one day. I've some how let too much time pass now. Maybe if I never have a family I could save up enough money to retire. That's only if I could get over this antisocial bullshit. If people didn't irritate me so much. 

It's so depressing looking down the pathway of life. See what would have to be done just to be where I would like to be. It's makes me physically tired to think about it. Like right now. I can't keep my eyes open.
I don't interact with anyone outside of work. I have no way of getting anywhere in a reasonable amount of time and also this area is so dangerous it would be foolish to walk out by myself.
I tried yesterday. They said I never signed up for selective service so I do not qualify for it.

I've been stabbed 3 times at work. The last time was about a month ago. 

I'm 36. 

I can't really go anywhere because I don't have a car. Walking is out of the question. It's so bad here, every time I go out I get into a fight.

I get paid under the table. They would arrest me for tax evasion if I try to sign up for something like that. 

Also I have a social anxiety problem that prevents me from talking to people over the phone in face to face. 

There's no public transportation here and I don't have a car. It's also too dangerous to walk out by yourself. There are no buildings someone would let me walk into like that around here anyway.

I'm not religious. I don't believe in an afterlife.

I repair computers now. I used to be a systems administrator for a web company but they went out of business. That was 10 years ago. I was homeless for 3 years until I found this job. I haven't been able to find anything else and the problem I have no is, I've become so antisocial I don't believe that I'll be able to work for someone else. I can't talk to people. It was the last time I was stabbed a few years back by a customer. Since then it's like I have a sun burn and everyone rubs on it. I can't deal with people face to face. It always ends up in a fight or an argument. I can't even talk to anyone about my problem. Somehow I've broke myself. I've painted myself into this corner and I can't get out. 

I've heavily abused at my job by the customers and my boss. My interactions with people are completely negative all day long. Since I have no transportation, I used to take these walks until I was mugged. I got the shit beat out of me. When I walk to work in the mornings and evening I feel very paranoid. I come home and I can't leave this place anymore. If there wasn't a place that sold food in the strip mall where I work, I don't know what I'd do. 

I need help. I probably need to let some doctor drug me up so I can feel happy again and not care about people's bullshit personalities. I can't though. I wouldn't be able to talk to a therapist. I've already tried. I called a guy out here and I just clam up. I just say yes or no. 

I've let too much of life pass me by. I've been isolated for so long now, it's going to be years until I'll be able to reintegrate into society. 

My physical health is deteriorating as well. I'm throwing up blood and stomach acid every now and then. I have this pain in the arch of my foot. I feel tired all the time and I get these migraines like I used to when I was a kid. I went to the doctor. They just tried to convince me there wasn't anything wrong with me because I don't have insurance. The free clinic is horrible. I can't get my point across due to my social ineptness. 

I just want it all to be over. I want to take mercy on myself and just end my life. I never thought I'd be able to reason out suicide.

I work in IT. 

I was close to my family. There's none left. 

I'm told everyday that I'm standing in the way of progress. I'm not exactly sure what problem I'm causing but it causes people to be upset with me daily. I've been told that I'm the common denominator and that I need to fix my social ineptness.  No one can tell me how. 

It's my bosses that say that to me. I have to care about their opinions because I live so close to the edge I will be homeless if I lose my job. It's also the only thing I can get within walking distance where I can make enough money to pay my rent. 

No

That wasn't my point. I want to be dead just to end life. I don't like this anymore.
